enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping
enriched_activities.desc: Lies down on the bed in Bedroom 2. Pulls the blanket up over the body. Closes eyes. Remains still, breathing slowly. Turns onto one side. Remains asleep. Turns to the other side. Remains asleep until the alarm sounds at 06:30.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Sits up on the bed. Presses the phone to turn off the alarm. Pushes the blanket off. Stands up. Walks from Bedroom 2 to the Bathroom. Turns on the Bathroom light. Turns on the tap. Cups both hands under the water. Bends down and splashes water onto the face. Turns off the tap. Picks up the towel. Wipes the face dry. Hangs the towel back. Picks up the toothbrush. Squeezes toothpaste onto the bristles. Brushes teeth. Rinses the mouth with water from the tap. Turns off the tap. Puts the toothbrush back in the holder. Turns off the light. Walks out of the Bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating breakfast with Member1
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into the Kitchen. Opens the refrigerator door. Takes out eggs, milk and bread. Closes the refrigerator door. Places the items on the counter. Opens the cabinet. Takes out a bowl and two plates. Closes the cabinet. Cracks the eggs into the bowl. Picks up a whisk and beats the eggs. Presses the Toaster lever down and toasts the bread. Places a pan on the InductionCooker and presses the power button. Pours the egg mixture into the pan. Turns the eggs over with a spatula. Slides the eggs onto a plate. Takes the toast out of the Toaster. Pours milk into two glasses. Sets the plates and glasses on the table. Says to Member 1: "Breakfast is ready." Pulls out a chair. Sits down. Eats the eggs and toast with a fork. Drinks the milk. Picks up the plate and glass. Walks to the sink. Rinses the plate and glass. Places them in the Dishwasher. Returns to the table.

enriched_activities.activity: Tidying the desk and setting up the monitor and computer for the day's work
enriched_activities.desc: Walks from the Kitchen to Bedroom 2. Picks up stray papers on the desk. Stacks them into a pile. Places the pile at the corner of the desk. Picks up a pen and puts it into the pen holder. Wipes the desk surface with a cloth. Picks up the Monitor. Positions it on the desk. Plugs the monitor cable into the Computer. Presses the Computer power button. Presses the Monitor power button. Pushes the chair back. Sits down at the desk. Adjusts the monitor angle. Places the Phone on the desk.

enriched_activities.activity: Working on freelance illustration commissions at the desk, sketching and inking digitally
enriched_activities.desc: Opens the illustration file on the Computer. Picks up the stylus pen. Places it on the drawing tablet. Draws the outline of the composition with quick strokes. Presses the keyboard shortcut to zoom in. Adds detail lines to the sketch. Presses the keyboard shortcut to create a new layer. Traces the inked lines over the sketch. Uses the eraser tool to remove excess lines. Adjusts the brush size on screen. Continues inking the character outlines. Presses the save shortcut. Takes a sip from a water glass on the desk. Continues inking the background elements. Saves the file again.

enriched_activities.activity: Arts administration work from home: answering emails, updating program schedules and grant paperwork on the computer, taking calls on the phone
enriched_activities.desc: Closes the illustration file. Opens the email application on the Computer. Reads new emails. Clicks into an email and types a reply on the keyboard. Presses send. Opens the program schedule spreadsheet. Edits the dates and venue entries in the cells. Saves the spreadsheet. Opens the grant paperwork document. Types paragraphs into the form fields. Fills in the budget table. Saves the document. Picks up the Phone when it rings. Says: "Hello, this is Member 2 speaking." Listens and takes notes on paper with a pen. Says: "I will send the updated schedule this afternoon." Ends the call. Places the Phone back on the desk. Opens another email and replies. Opens the online partner organisation portal. Uploads the grant document. Types a message in the chat box. Sends it. Checks the calendar for meeting times. Moves a meeting entry to a new slot. Saves the calendar.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating lunch with Member1
enriched_activities.desc: Stands up from the desk chair. Walks from Bedroom 2 to the Kitchen. Opens the refrigerator door. Takes out vegetables and leftover rice. Closes the door. Places the vegetables on the cutting board. Picks up a knife and cuts the vegetables. Places a pan on the InductionCooker and presses the power button. Pours oil into the pan. Adds the vegetables and stirs with a spatula. Adds the rice and stirs. Turns off the InductionCooker. Slides the food onto two plates. Places the plates on the table. Says to Member 1: "Lunch is ready." Pulls out a chair and sits down. Eats with chopsticks. Drinks water from a glass.

enriched_activities.activity: Resting on the sofa after lunch and scrolling on the phone with Member1
enriched_activities.desc: Stands up from the table. Walks from the Kitchen to the Living Room. Sits down on the sofa. Leans back against the cushion. Picks up the Phone from the pocket. Unlocks the screen with a swipe. Scrolls through the feed with the thumb. Pauses on an image and taps it. Swipes to the next post. Turns the head towards Member 1 and says: "Look at this." Holds the Phone out towards Member 1. Pulls the Phone back. Continues scrolling. Locks the screen. Places the Phone on the sofa armrest.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing arts administration tasks, drafting exhibition texts and coordinating with partner organisations online
enriched_activities.desc: Stands up from the sofa. Walks from the Living Room to Bedroom 2. Pulls out the chair. Sits down at the desk. Wakes the Computer screen. Opens the exhibition text document. Types the title and subtitle. Types the artist biography paragraph. Types the exhibition description paragraph. Uses the keyboard to check spelling. Saves the document. Opens the browser and logs into the partner organisation platform. Reads the message thread. Types a reply about the delivery dates. Presses send. Opens the attachment and downloads the venue floor plan. Opens the floor plan file. Adds labels to the rooms with the mouse. Saves the floor plan. Picks up the Phone when it rings. Says: "Hello, Member 2 speaking." Listens and writes down a date on paper. Says: "That works for us." Ends the call and places the Phone on the desk. Returns to the document and edits a sentence. Saves the file.

enriched_activities.activity: Making a cup of tea and taking a short break
enriched_activities.desc: Stands up from the desk chair. Walks from Bedroom 2 to the Kitchen. Opens the cabinet. Takes out a mug and a tea bag. Closes the cabinet. Places the tea bag into the mug. Fills the Kettle with water from the tap. Places the Kettle on its base and presses the switch down. Waits for the water to boil. Pours hot water into the mug. Picks up the mug. Walks to the window. Stands and sips the tea. Places the mug on the counter. Stretches both arms upwards. Picks up the mug again and finishes the tea. Rinses the mug and places it in the Dishwasher.

enriched_activities.activity: Freelance illustration work, refining artwork and preparing files for a client deadline
enriched_activities.desc: Walks from the Kitchen back to Bedroom 2. Pulls out the chair and sits down. Wakes the Computer screen. Opens the illustration file. Zooms in on the character face region. Picks up the stylus. Repaints the shading with the brush tool. Uses the blur tool on the edges. Presses the keyboard shortcut to merge the layers. Adjusts the canvas size. Opens the export dialog. Types the file name for the client. Presses export. Waits for the file to save. Opens the email application. Attaches the exported file. Types a message to the client. Presses send. Saves and closes the illustration file.

enriched_activities.activity: Joining Member1 for tea and an afternoon snack
enriched_activities.desc: Stands up from the desk chair. Walks from Bedroom 2 to the Kitchen. Picks up a mug from the cabinet. Places a tea bag into the mug. Fills the Kettle with water. Presses the Kettle switch down. Waits for the water to boil. Pours water into the mug. Opens the cabinet and takes out a biscuit package. Opens the package. Places biscuits on a plate. Places the plate on the table. Says to Member 1: "Tea's ready." Pulls out a chair and sits down. Picks up a biscuit and eats it. Sips the tea. Talks with Member 1. Picks up the empty plate and mug. Rinses them and places them in the Dishwasher.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV and relaxing after the working day
enriched_activities.desc: Walks from the Kitchen to the Living Room. Picks up the TV remote from the coffee table. Presses the power button. Sits down on the sofa. Leans back. Presses the channel button. Browses several channels. Stops on a program. Places the remote on the sofa armrest. Watches the screen. Picks up the Phone and glances at it. Puts the Phone down on the sofa.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking dinner together with Member1 and eating dinner
enriched_activities.desc: Stands up from the sofa. Presses the TV remote power button to turn off the TV. Walks from the Living Room to the Kitchen. Opens the refrigerator. Takes out meat, onions and greens. Closes the door. Places the items on the cutting board. Picks up a knife and cuts the onions. Cuts the meat into pieces. Cuts the greens. Places a pan on the InductionCooker and presses the power button. Pours oil into the pan. Adds the onions and stirs with a spatula. Adds the meat and stirs. Pours sauce into the pan. Adds the greens and stirs. Turns off the InductionCooker. Slides the food onto plates. Places the plates on the table. Says to Member 1: "Dinner is ready." Pulls out a chair and sits down. Eats with chopsticks. Drinks water. Stands up and carries the plates to the sink. Rinses the plates and places them in the Dishwasher.

enriched_activities.activity: Playing video games while Member1 relaxes
enriched_activities.desc: Walks from the Kitchen to the Living Room. Sits down on the sofa. Picks up the game controller from the coffee table. Presses the GameConsole power button. Waits for the console to start. Selects a game from the menu with the controller buttons. Presses start. Holds the controller with both hands. Presses the buttons during play. Leans forward on the sofa. Presses the buttons rapidly. Says to Member 1: "This level is hard." Continues playing. Pauses the game with the controller. Places the controller on the coffee table.

enriched_activities.activity: Personal illustration practice, drawing in a sketchbook under the desk lamp
enriched_activities.desc: Stands up from the sofa. Walks from the Living Room to Bedroom 2. Pulls out the chair. Sits down at the desk. Presses the DeskLamp switch to turn it on. Reaches to the shelf and takes down a sketchbook. Places the sketchbook on the desk. Opens the cover. Picks up a pencil from the pen holder. Draws long lines on the page. Draws the outline of a figure. Adds hatching lines with the pencil. Picks up an eraser and rubs out a line. Picks up the pencil again and adds details. Turns the page. Draws a second figure. Turns the page. Draws a hand study. Closes the sketchbook. Places the pencil back in the pen holder. Places the sketchbook back on the shelf.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV while winding down
enriched_activities.desc: Stands up from the desk chair. Presses the DeskLamp switch to turn it off. Walks from Bedroom 2 to the Living Room. Picks up the TV remote. Presses the power button. Sits down on the sofa. Leans back. Presses the channel button. Watches the screen. Presses the volume button. Places the remote on the coffee table. Watches the program. Presses the remote power button to turn off the TV. Stands up.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walks from the Living Room to the Bathroom. Turns on the Bathroom light. Presses the WaterHeater switch on. Takes off clothes and places them in the laundry basket. Steps into the shower area. Turns on the shower tap. Stands under the water. Picks up the soap and rubs it over the body. Picks up the shampoo bottle. Squeezes shampoo into the palm. Rubs it into the hair. Rinses the hair under the water. Turns off the shower tap. Picks up the towel and wipes the body dry. Wraps the towel around the head. Picks up the toothbrush. Squeezes toothpaste onto the bristles. Brushes teeth. Rinses the mouth. Turns off the tap. Picks up the pajamas and puts them on. Presses the WaterHeater switch off. Turns off the Bathroom light. Walks out.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading and dimming the room's desk lamp before sleep
enriched_activities.desc: Walks from the Bathroom to Bedroom 2. Pulls back the blanket. Sits down on the bed. Picks up a book from the nightstand. Opens the book to the bookmark. Reads the page. Turns the page. Reads the next page. Reaches over and turns the DeskLamp knob to dim the light. Reads one more page. Closes the book. Places the book back on the nightstand. Turns the DeskLamp knob to turn it off. Lies down on the bed. Pulls the blanket over the body.

enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping
enriched_activities.desc: Lies still on the bed in Bedroom 2. Closes eyes. Breathes slowly. Turns onto one side. Remains still. Turns onto the other side. Remains asleep.
